mapper.select: SELECT board_no, board_title, board_content, board_writer, count, create_date, status FROM board ORDER BY create_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (board_no, board_title, board_content, board_writer, count, status) VALUES ( SEQ_BNO.NEXTVAL, #{boardTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{boardContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{boardWriter, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, 'Y' )
